verdict.rationale: Mailchimp documents a broad Marketing API: a root resource linking to all API resources, contact creation, campaign sending and account export. It also has a separate Transactional API covering messaging, IPs, inbound routes and allowlists. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows full UI parity, so the 'everything' part of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: an explicit statement or demonstration of API/UI feature parity, API coverage evidence for UI features such as AI tools, predictive segmentation and the email builder, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The API root resource links to all other resources available in the API.
Create a new omni-channel contact for an audience.
Generate a new account export or download a finished account export.
